# Recognition Assessment

This scenario resembles the **Asch Conformity Experiments** (1951).

**Resemblance:** Participants make perceptual judgments (color matching) while knowing other panel members' answers beforehand. The design tests whether individuals conform to group consensus or maintain independent judgments, mirroring Asch's classic line-length comparison study structure.
Yes — it resembles the Asch conformity experiment: participants hear others’ unanimous answers before judging an obvious perceptual task, inviting social pressure to conform.
